title: Dulce Maria Alavez missing: Family marks 7 years since girl vanished from NJ park
text:
The gathering took place near the park swing where Dulce's mother, Noema Alavez, last saw her daughter in 2019.
The gathering took place near the park swing where Dulce's mother, Noema Alavez, last saw her daughter in 2019. Dulce was 5 years old when she disappeared while playing with her younger brother at the park.
Noema was in her vehicle at the time.
"It's been 7 years, and me and my family, we never thought it was going to be this long," Noema said. Brenda Trinidad, an organizer of the event, said they return each year to honor Dulce and maintain public awareness of the case.
"That person took advantage of that day when Dulce came here. She didn't come here to be taken; she came here to have a good time," Trinidad said. Mother of Dulce Maria Alavez expresses regret, defies critics one year after child vanishedThe mother of Dulce Maria Alavez, the little girl who vanished while playing in a park, spoke to Action News on the one year anniversary of the child's disappearance.
Loved ones hope the images, along with the yearly gathering, will generate information that could aid investigators. In a statement, the Cumberland County Prosecutor's Office said, "It's incredibly frustrating to know that this case has not been solved. We remain committed to doing whatever is within our power to find those responsible for Dulce's disappearance.
"Investigators continue reviewing tips and developing leads in the case. Meanwhile, Dulce's loved ones said they won't give up.
"Me and my mom and her siblings, we miss her a lot. We're not going to stop until we find her," Alavez said. Authorities ask anyone with information about her disappearance or whereabouts to contact the Cumberland County Prosecutor's Office, New Jersey State Police or the FBI.36 minutes ago
